risk_note: RV2 (union + orders read; order ownership evidence). D10-796 ② (甲) / D10-809: the archive (union_raw_payloads) of 大淘客 get-order-refund requests keeps only the rows of 凑狸's stored taobao orders. Refund records carry no promotion slot, so orders exports a read-only readOwnTaobaoOrderNos (app.orders, same app_id, platform taobao, sub_order_id or parent_order_id verbatim; empty input reads nothing), injected by app.module through UnionModuleOptions.taobaoOwnOrders (B1-22q precedent; union does not import orders). listRefunds passes an async archiveBody: rows whose tb_trade_id is readable (same reading as requiredId: '--' and blank are unreadable) and not in the answer are dropped; unreadable rows, outer members and JSON number literals are kept; nothing to drop returns the body unchanged. A failed lookup stores the body as received with the new error_code archive_body_lookup_failed (ArchiveBodyLookupError); a non-JSON body keeps the existing empty payload + archive_body_rewrite_failed. Without the port the refund archive is unchanged (frozen [AC-B1-04zzc#11] untouched). listRefunds items, nextCursor and warnings are unchanged; a refund that precedes its order's storage is not archived but still returned (D10-796). No write, no lock, no amount change.
